article.title: Book Review: A guide to how the media sanitized Israel’s genocide in Gaza
article.author: James North
article.content: Assal Rad's 'Don't Say Palestine' is a masterpiece on language distortion and dishonesty, combining brilliant analysis with searing moral outrage and destined to become a classic read for years to come.
